    else:

    e_perp = e_perp - np.dot(e_perp, e1)*e1
    e_perp /= np.linalg.norm(e_perp)
    e2 = np.cross(e1, e_perp)
    sin_theta = np.sqrt(max(1 - cos_theta**2, 0.0))
    return cos_theta * e1 + sin_theta * np.cos(phi) * e_perp + sin_theta * np.sin(phi) * e2
